description: The pages AI answers cite for your tracked questions, in three lists: top (most answers in the last 30 days), new (cited in the last 30 days and not the 30 before) and losing (fewer answers than the 30 days before). Each page has its domain, its type, whose site it is (brand, competitive, ugc or editorial, and the competitor on a competitor's page), its answers in both periods, the article format that gets pages like it (formatOff when that format is off in your writing settings), whether it can be pitched for a mention (hasProducts is false until you add a product or service), and whether it's a discussion to reply in. New and losing stay empty until the 30 days before have answers.

engines.description: Only these engines' answers: their ids, comma-separated (chatgpt, perplexity, claude, gemini, grok, google_ai_mode, google_ai_overview). Leave it out for all seven.

topic.description: One topic's questions only: its id or name from get_topics, or none for questions with no topic. Leave it out for the whole workspace.

name: get_cited_pages
